modules.name: Datamatic
modules.description: Data-driven rhythm after Ryoji Ikeda: pi, e, primes, Fibonacci, counting, text, seeded random or a CV become a 4-64 bit loop that four interlocking gate lanes read at up to 16x the clock, with accelerating rolls, cuts to digital silence and bit mutation

modules.name: Test Pattern
modules.description: Four hard-edged Ikeda voices for Datamatic: a sub sine, a sine tone (low, 1 kHz test tone or very high) with left/right beating, single-sample clicks and white noise bursts; no envelopes, one LINK cable from Datamatic
